## About
Servistar Construction, Inc. is a Los Angeles based remodeler specializing in kitchen and bathroom remodeling. We're a locally family owned and operated business, and we value what our clients value: honesty, integrity, doing what's right, doing it as promised, and doing it at a fair price.
Remodeling lets you stay in the home you love without the hassle of moving. We sit down with you one-on-one to figure out where to start, then handle the planning, the design and the install under one roof.
A lot of our work comes from people who tell their friends, family and neighbors about us. One reviewer said they were referred by their neighbor. We're rated 5 on Google from 39 reviews.

## Services
- Kitchen: We go over design, special features, flooring, appliances, backsplash, cabinets and any structural repairs, then give you an affordable budget and a realistic timeline.
- Bathroom: Bathroom remodels are a big part of what we do, from master bathrooms to full updates with new tile and showers.
- Foundation: Foundation work for your home, handled by our team.
- Framing: Framing for remodels, including reworking a floor plan for a new family room.
- Int & Exterior Painting: Painting inside and out.
- Energy Efficiency and Remodeling: Upgrades that help your home use less energy, like updated appliances, low-flow faucets and replacement windows.
- Roofing: Ask about roofing when you send in your inquiry.
- Windows and Doors: Ask about windows and doors when you send in your inquiry.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us and one of our team specialists will arrange a free estimate.

Q: Can I get an estimate over the phone?
A: Yes, we offer over-the-phone estimates, and you can also send a request through our quick quote form.

Q: Are your contractors licensed?
A: Yes. Our contractors are licensed and insured.

Q: Can you work around my schedule?
A: We'll start early or stay late when we need to so the work fits your schedule.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
